observations: 2014 PLOS ONE study testing capsaicin during 3T3-L1 preadipocyte differentiation for brite/brown-like markers.

entities.name: Capsaicin
observations: Low-dose exposure during 3T3-L1 differentiation was reported to induce brown-like marker-gene expression; higher-dose effects differed.

entities.name: 3T3-L1 preadipocytes
observations: Murine preadipocyte model used to assess capsaicin effects during adipogenic differentiation.

entities.name: Capsaicin brite induction
observations: During 3T3-L1 differentiation, low-dose capsaicin increased expression of brown-fat marker genes and induced a brown-like phenotype; response was dose-dependent.
